members.member: Member string properties. For the local member, successful [method PlayFabLobby.set_member_properties_async] writes are reflected eagerly in this snapshot; remote member updates arrive through SDK-driven [code]MEMBER_UPDATED[/code] changes.
Whether this is the local user for the lobby handle.

Whether this member currently has a live connection to the lobby; one of [constant CONNECTION_STATUS_NOT_CONNECTED] or [constant CONNECTION_STATUS_CONNECTED]. A member that drops offline stays in [member PlayFabLobby.members] with a [constant CONNECTION_STATUS_NOT_CONNECTED] status until it is actually removed, so use this rather than membership to decide whether to hold a slot, pause, or reassign a role.

constants.constant: The member is in the lobby but has no live connection to it.
The member is in the lobby and connected to it.
